note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(节日主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: On her first Spring Festival in China, Emma felt a little lost among the noise and the bright red decorations. Her host family welcomed her warmly, taught her to make dumplings, and gave her lucky money in a red envelope. By the end of the night, watching the smiling faces around the table, she finally understood why this festival means so much to so many people.

questions.q: How did Emma feel at the start of the festival?
options: Slightly confused by all the noise and red decorations.
Sure that she already knew everything.
questions.explanation: 原文 'felt a little lost among the noise and the bright red decorations' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What helped Emma understand the festival by the end of the night?
options: Reading a long history book alone.
Seeing the happy people gathered around the table.
questions.explanation: 末句 'watching the smiling faces around the table, she finally understood' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
